title: Contradictory route preservation with advisory normalization
failure_signature: A live route narrative contains duplicate app-seat ownership and a missing sequential phase while also introducing future unnamed CLI seats.
trigger_preconditions: A live workflow changes cycle membership or phase ownership and its narrated assignments are not sequential.
candidate_workaround: Preserve submitted assignments, emit the exact issues, generate a sequential candidate from the declared sixteen-seat cycle, and mark ownership changes as requiring confirmation.
recurrence_guard: Never activate, rename, message, or pre-name a future CLI seat merely to make a schedule fit.
rollback: Keep the raw failing audit and use the candidate only as advisory teaching material until the live route is confirmed.
scope_boundary: Workflow-plan structure only; no future CLI sibling is created, named, activated, or granted authority.
